'''Zakar''' was a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Warrior caste|warrior]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] he fought on the uninhabitable [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dibrook]] against [[New Republic soldier/Legends|New Republic troopers]] [[Rescue Mission to Dibrook|searching]] for refugees captured during the [[Battle of Dibrook]]. He managed to capture the [[Captain/Legends|captain]], but when he wanted to kill him he was stopped by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Tsalok]]. Tsalok, making sure that others of the captain's group could see, then tore off the captain's [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suit]], killing him as a warning.

He was later sent to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to assist [[Yarmond]] in capturing [[Finn Galfridian]]. He grappled with [[Kopri]], captain of the [[Palace Guard (New Republic)|Palace Guard]] in an attempt to force Finn to surrender, but was beheaded by Master [[Dray (Fallen Jedi)|Dray]].
